articles.title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
articles.snippet: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners are oversold following 35% October rout, VanEck says
articles.snippet: Investors dumped AI infrastructure providers across the board in October, treating companies in very different sectors as one monolithic trade.

articles.title: South Korea seeks 4th crypto tax delay, targets 2029 start
articles.snippet: South Korea is seeking a fourth delay to its 22% crypto tax, months after reaffirming plans to begin taxing digital asset gains in January 2027.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin says phased reopening to begin Monday, will cover losses
articles.snippet: Customers will initially be able to view their holdings, while withdrawals and trading remain suspended pending security checks.

articles.title: Trump-linked tokens lead crypto losses after Democrats sweep in the US midterms
articles.snippet: The official Trump and World Liberty Financial tokens were the two biggest losers among the top 100 cryptocurrencies on Wednesday, even as Bitcoin and Ether rallied.
